description: This file is a base class for AMQP protocol integration tests in a Java project related to Eclipse Hono. It contains abstract methods for creating message consumers, getting endpoint info, setup and teardown logic, and multiple test cases verifying message upload and rejection scenarios via AMQP. It also includes utility methods for setting up the protocol adapter connections and message sending workflows.

classes.name: AmqpUploadTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for AMQP integration tests, providing setup, teardown, and test utility methods for verifying AMQP message handling via the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform additional checks on received messages.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message consumer for a specific tenant.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Abstract method returning the endpoint name used in tests.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test, logging the test name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleanup method executed after each test, deleting objects and closing connections.

methods.name: testAdapterRejectsBadInboundMessage
methods.description: Test verifying adapter rejects messages with empty notification content type.

methods.name: testAnonymousRelayRequired
methods.description: Test checking that the adapter rejects links with a target address.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingSaslPlain
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying message upload via SASL PLAIN authentication.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingSaslExternal
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying message upload via SASL EXTERNAL authentication.

methods.name: testUploadMessages
methods.description: Utility method to upload and verify a number of messages using a specific sender QoS.

methods.name: doUploadMessages
methods.description: Core method for sending a batch of messages and verifying their receipt.

methods.name: setupProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Helper to set up and connect a device to the protocol adapter with optional tenant disable.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up open connections and resources after tests.
